top_signals.title: Russia’s Shadow Role in Iran War Comes Under Fresh Scrutiny
top_signals.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov traveled to Iran on October 19, meeting with President Masud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi amid questions over what support Moscow is providing Tehran to fight its war with the United States. Lavrov traveled to the Iranian capital directly from Manama, Bahrain, where he had attended a meeting with Gulf Cooperation Council officials. Gulf states have urged Moscow to use its influence to press Tehran to halt attacks on its neighbors. Lavrov also met with Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.

top_signals.title: Senegal Bonds Plunge as Budget Standoff Puts IMF Deal at Risk
top_signals.summary: Senegal’s dollar bonds suffered their biggest drop since early September after opposition leader Ousmane Sonko threatened to block a revised 2026 budget and the government’s spending plan for next year.
